evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
mechanics_notes: 500-Ki Strike Ultimate from Hit, obtainable through the Dragon Ball wish for an Ultimate Attack. A very short-range opening punch places the opponent into the time-skip sequence, after which a rapid barrage lands and the accumulated blows resolve together when the skip ends. The hit has grab/pseudo-grab properties once connected but can be blocked; exact frame data and universal damage scaling remain unresolved.
